commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' That was really pointless! Bilal Brahimi (Brest) made a mindless challenge and the referee Jerome Brisard showed him a red card.
90+4' Imran Louza (Lorient) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jerome Brisard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90+2' The referee blows his whistle as Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) was too aggressive in his challenge.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Mahdi Camara will be replaced by Bilal Brahimi (Brest).
89' The substitution has been made. Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) has replaced Martin Satriano.
86' 0 - 1 Romain Del Castillo (Brest) strikes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes straight inside the left post!
85' The corner kick from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
84' Lilian Brassier (Brest) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
82' Lorient have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' Substitution. Imran Louza (Lorient) has come on for Laurent Abergel.
80' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Bamba Dieng (Lorient).
80' Lilian Brassier (Brest) is booked for saying more than Jerome Brisard was willing to tolerate.
76' Today's referee Jerome Brisard rightly decides to book Jonas Martin (Brest) for his harsh tackle.
74' Substitution. Bamba Dieng (Lorient) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mohamed Bamba walks off.
74' Here is a change. Badredine Bouanani is going off and Regis Le Bris gives the last tactical orders to Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient).
73' Substitution. Mathias Pereira Lage makes way for Steve Mounie (Brest).

72' Mahdi Camara (Brest) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jerome Brisard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
69' Regis Le Bris has decided to make a change. Theo Le Bris (Lorient) replaces Panos Katseris.
68' Substitution. Ayman Kari (Lorient) in, Julien Ponceau out.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brest.
67' It looks like Isaak Toure (Lorient) saw red with that tackle. Jerome Brisard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
65' A substitution has been made. Hugo Magnetti goes off and Kamory Doumbia (Brest) comes on.
64' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Jeremy Le Douaron and he is replaced by Romain Del Castillo (Brest).
62' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) is adjudged offside.
59' Lilian Brassier (Brest) leaps like a salmon and plants a great close-range header from the corner towards goal, but the effort is blocked at the last moment.
58' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is about to take a corner kick.
56' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) commits a foul after dangerous play.
54' The game is interrupted. Panos Katseris (Lorient) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
54' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) heads on.
51' Formose Mendy (Lorient) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
50' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Badredine Bouanani (Lorient) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Marco Bizot makes a smart save to deny him.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Kenny Lala (Brest), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Mahdi Camara (Brest) handles the ball inside the box.
42' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
41' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
37' Panos Katseris (Lorient) takes a snap shot on the edge of the box, but it sails well wide of the right post.
36' Dangerous play by Jonas Martin (Brest). Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
36' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
34' The linesman raises his flag. Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) is adjudged offside.
34' Lorient concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
31' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Lorient as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
31' Referee Jerome Brisard makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lorient. Let’s see what happens!
28' Surely that's handball by one of the Brest players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
28' Badredine Bouanani (Lorient) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
26' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Lorient failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
24' Panos Katseris (Lorient) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Lorient will take a corner kick.
22' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) commits a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for an infringement.
21' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lorient comes to nothing.
20' Badredine Bouanani (Lorient) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Marco Bizot.
18' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
17' Lorient take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
15' The corner is swung in but Lorient can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
14' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.

10' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches over the crossbar.
9' Jerome Brisard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Brendan Chardonnet (Brest). There is a free kick near the sideline to Lorient.
6' Mahdi Camara (Brest) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.

5' Lorient players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
2' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Lorient will kick the game off.
Jerome Brisard is the one to supervise the game today.
